purpose: prevent EQIR from claiming algorithmic value by comparing only with weak or historically convenient baselines

comparators.name: FROZEN_QUERY_BALANCED_BASE_ONLY
comparators.definition: the already frozen fold-specific DTIAM-BioMaster query-balanced blend; no structure feature or learned refit

comparators.name: TCP_INSPIRED_ELIGIBLE_SUBSET_CONFIDENCE_FUSION
comparators.evaluation_population: only pairs with a(t)=1; the same eligible pair set must be used for EQIR and base comparisons
comparators.mechanism: each modality has a learned binary logit head and a sigmoid confidence head; the confidence target is that modality head's probability assigned to the true class; normalized confidence-weighted logits feed a two-layer fusion MLP
comparators.objective: fused binary cross entropy plus both modality binary cross entropies plus both TCP confidence MSE losses
comparators.important_difference_from_eqir: may learn the complete eligible-subset label and has no residual-only restriction or exact no-evidence invariant

comparators.name: TCP_INSPIRED_MASKED_ALL_TARGET_CONFIDENCE_FUSION
comparators.evaluation_population: all S3 development pairs, including the 46 targets recovered only because the experimental pocket is missing
comparators.inputs: the same inputs as the eligible-subset control plus a(t) and a learned missing-structure token
comparators.mechanism: mask structure TCP loss and structure confidence when a(t)=0; the nonstructural modality remains learned and may differ from the frozen base
comparators.important_difference_from_eqir: generic missing-modality fusion; no bitwise base fallback and no residual-only restriction

comparators.name: EQIR_FULL
comparators.definition: the parent Stage1 freeze as corrected by the probability-scale objective amendment

shared_training_protocol.inner_validation: identical deterministic grouped inner folds jointly respecting target homology cluster and drug scaffold group
shared_training_protocol.selection_objective: equal-weight mean of inner-validation micro AUPRC, target-macro AUPRC and drug-macro AUPRC
selection_constraints: drug-macro must not be below the frozen base
target-macro may be at most 0.002 below the frozen base
held TEST labels are never used for fitting, tuning, confidence calibration or checkpoint selection
shared_training_protocol.capacity_matching: TCP-inspired modality and fusion MLP widths must be selected from parameter counts no smaller than 0.5x and no larger than 2x the full EQIR trainable parameter count; ties choose the smaller model

mandatory_reporting.five_seed_rule: at least 4/5 seed differences versus each comparator are positive
mandatory_reporting.official_name_policy: never label either TCP-inspired control as an official DrugCMF reproduction

mmtf_dti_policy.reason: the released preprocessing tuple order and training consumer order swap compound/protein graph and feature semantics; an exact faithful port is not currently auditable
mmtf_dti_policy.allowed_future_action: only after upstream clarification or an explicitly documented repair, evaluate a corrected MMTF-inspired port under the same S1-S5 splits
mmtf_dti_policy.forbidden_claim: do not report a repaired local implementation as the official MMTF-DTI reproduction
